# The published matrix

<!-- generated by tools/matrix from docs/matrix.json; edit the manifest, then run `go run ./tools/matrix write`. Do not edit this page by hand. -->

This page is generated from one manifest in the tree (`docs/matrix.json`) and printed with each release. It is the same table the board shows, at the moment of the release: the feature-by-language cells (✅ shipped, ❌ not built) and one maturity state per language column.

The page ships red. A ❌ cell and a language marked **coming** are honest states printed as they stand at each release, never reasons to hold a release or to hide a column.
